audit.ratio_rule: achieved_ha / target_ha when target_ha > 0. Ratios above 1 are kept. target_ha <= 0 is not replaced with 1.
audit.asof_rule: same crop, official source season equals the forecast Monday operational season, available_date <= forecast Monday
audit.lightgbm_params_source: notebook fixed hyperparameters; Optuna was not run
